rtk.purpose: Compress shell/tool output 60-90% before LLM context
rtk.install_note: Official: brew install rtk OR cargo install --git https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk — do not confuse with crates.io rust-type-kit
rtk.governance: filter noise only; tee full output on failure; no secret stripping as a hide-audit feature

codex_cli.install: curl https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh  OR npm i -g @openai/codex OR brew install --cask codex
codex_cli.role: local coding agent; complementary not replacement for MA-OS-12
